reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni jiddiy cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta shart bor; ularga aniqlik kiritilmaguncha qatnashish tavsiya etilmaydi.

Lot hajmiga nomutanosib moliyaviy talab (4-bet): Lotning boshlang'ich narxi 738 214 477 so'm, ya'ni to'liq ball uchun talab qilinadigan 5 mlrd so'm bank aylanmasi lot qiymatidan taxminan 6,8 baravar ko'p. 1 mlrd so'mgacha aylanmali ishtirokchi 8 ball yo'qotadi; o'tish bali 75/85 bo'lgani uchun bu ularni saralashdan chiqarib yuborishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, 20 foiz aylanma mablag' bo'yicha alohida mezon ham bor.

Lot hajmiga nomutanosib tajriba yoki resurs talabi (3-bet): To'liq ball uchun 6 va undan ko'p o'xshash shartnoma talab qilinadi, 1-4 shartnoma esa faqat 2 ball beradi (8 ball farq). Ish hajmi 0,532 km quvur va 738 mln so'm bo'lgan lot uchun bu ko'p, o'tish bali 75/85 bo'lgani uchun esa amalda 6 ta shartnomasiz ishtirokchi chiqib ketadi. Oraliqlar ham bir-biriga to'g'ri kelmaydi ("1 dan 4" va "4 dan 5").

Lot hajmiga nomutanosib tajriba yoki resurs talabi (3-bet): Doimiy xodimlar soni 15 dan kam bo'lsa ishtirokchi diskvalifikatsiya qilinadi, 25 va undan ko'p bo'lsa 10 ball oladi. 0,532 km quvurni ta'mirlash uchun bunday katta shtat shart emas; kichik, ammo litsenziyali va jihozlangan korxonalar chetlashtiriladi yoki ball yo'qotadi.

reasons_en: The document holds several conditions that may seriously limit competition; bidding is not advised until they are clarified.

Requirement unrelated to the subject of the purchase (page 3): Points depend on the construction ministry's rating of design organisations, and a bidder with rating D or no rating gets 0 points and is disqualified. The work is a repair to an already-expertised design, and a design-organisation rating is not directly tied to repair quality. With a pass mark of 75 out of a maximum 85, losing these 10 points practically means failing the screening.

Financial demand out of proportion to the lot (page 4): The start price is 738,214,477 UZS, so the 5 bn UZS annual bank turnover needed for full points is about 6.8 times the lot value. A bidder with turnover below 1 bn loses 8 points, and with a pass mark of 75 out of 85 that can mean elimination. A separate criterion already checks working capital of 20% of the object value.

Experience or resource demand out of proportion to the lot (page 3): Full points need 6 or more similar contracts, while 1-4 contracts earn only 2 points (an 8-point gap). For a 0.532 km pipeline lot worth 738 million UZS this is demanding, and with a pass mark of 75 out of 85 a bidder without 6 contracts is effectively out. The bands also overlap ("1 to 4" and "4 to 5").

Experience or resource demand out of proportion to the lot (page 3): A bidder with fewer than 15 permanent staff is disqualified and 25 or more earn the full 10 points. A repair of 0.532 km of pipeline does not obviously need a workforce that large, so small licensed and equipped firms are excluded or lose points.

Other clause that may limit competition (page 3): Years since company registration create up to an 8-point gap (10+ years earns 10, 1-5 years earns 2). A younger company with the licence, equipment and experienced staff still loses 8 points, which matters with a 75 out of 85 pass mark.
In the customer's last 22 deals the median number of bidders was 2; 64% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 14%.
Note: 1 page(s) of the document are scans without readable text and were not analysed.
